|#default|2|4|5=''[[Star Wars: Vader - Dark Visions]]'' takes place after the formation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] but prior to the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], depicted in [[Vader - Dark Visions 3|''Vader - Dark Visions'' 3]]. ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the formation of the Rebel Alliance to [[2 BBY]], and ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the event that immediately preceding the [[Battle of Yavin]] to [[1 BBY]]. Therefore, ''Star Wars: Vader - Dark Visions'' must take place between 2 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] and 1 BBY.
|1=''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Vader - Dark Visions 1|''Vader - Dark Visions'' 1]] to between around [[2 BBY]] and [[1 BBY]].
|3=[[Vader - Dark Visions 3|''Vader - Dark Visions'' 3]] takes place after the formation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]], depicted in the [[Vader - Dark Visions 2|previous]] and [[Vader - Dark Visions 4|following]] issues, but prior to the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], depicted in this issue. ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the formation of the Rebel Alliance to [[2 BBY]], and ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the event that immediately preceding the [[Battle of Yavin]] to [[1 BBY]].
